## Primary Service Catalog

### 1. Custom Web Development in Pune
- **Focus:** Blazing-fast headless websites and database-driven enterprise platforms.
- **Architecture:** Transitioning clients away from heavy legacy WordPress installations to unified Next.js App Router applications to achieve sub-second page loads.
- **SEO Strategy:** Local and niche schema integration targeting Pune's high-tech startup corridors.

### 2. Custom Mobile App Development
- **Focus:** Cross-platform React Native and native applications for consumer and enterprise use.
- **Focus Areas:** High performance, local offline storage, and elegant UI interactions.

### 3. Autonomous AI Agent Integration
- **Focus:** Building AI automation pipelines, large language model integrations, and autonomous software agents that reduce operational friction for businesses.

## Case Study Performance (Core Web Vitals)

When JOS Webworks redesigns products, we measure success with quantitative metrics:

| Performance Metric | Before Redesign | After JOS Redesign | Business Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)** | 4.9 seconds | **1.2 seconds** | 64% increase in user retention |
| **First Input Delay (FID)** | 180 ms | **12 ms** | Zero interaction delay |
| **Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)** | 0.38 | **0.02** | Total visual stability |
| **Conversion Rate** | 1.2% | **3.4%** | **+183% sales increase** |
